messages:
Aisha Khan: Quick sync  vendors surfaced region-specific validation gaps for MI300 and Gaudi. need a pragmatic marketplace + SI dry-run plan.
Tom Becker: what's the gap? perf, stability, or driver timing?
amd_suzanne: MI300: driver 5.3.2 regression under high-concurrency mmapping -> OOMs at batch>16. fix planned in 5.3.3 (~10 days).
Sven Korhonen: Gaudi: firmware 2.1.0 causes an 15-20% throughput derate on long tails; microcode hotfix ETA ~2026-06-10.
Jenny Park: proposal: staggered listing. NA/EU preview for both on 2026-06-20, APAC to follow after vendor validation (target early July). show "preview / limited capacity" UI flag.
Luc Moreau: infra will publish preview images: `redwood/mi300:preview-20260610` and `redwood/gaudi:preview-20260610`. smoke test command:
```
docker run --rm --gpus=all redwood/mi300:preview-20260610 python -m redwood.smoketest --concurrency 24 --batch-size 12
```
Tom Becker: SI dry-runs: NA/EU 2026-06-14, APAC dry-run 2026-06-28. SI checklist: p95/p99, memory footprint, KV warmup, autoscale triggers. I'll own matrix.
amd_suzanne: vendor will provide embargoed test plan by 06-18 and ship 5.3.3 to partners on 06-22.
nvidia_anna: we'll ship microcode hotfix to partners 06-10, partner validation window ~1 week.
Jenny Park: comms: draft marketplace wording to include fallback guidance (default fallback H200 then H100) and a short support Q&A.
legal-bot: Reminder: any region availability change requires legal sign-off before public listing.
release-bot: Pipeline queued: `marketplace-preview` NA/EU 2026-06-20 16:00 UTC pending sign-offs.
Aisha Khan: Decisions: partner preview 06-12/06-14 (integrators), NA/EU preview listing 06-20, APAC gated until vendor fixes validated (aim 07-05). Actions: Luc -> images, Tom -> SI matrix, Jenny -> listing copy + Q&A, Sven -> perf notes, Aisha -> legal/press.
Tom Becker: will circulate SI matrix by 2026-06-08.
Sven Korhonen: I'll attach lab logs and perf delta table 06-03.
Aisha Khan: thanks all. tagging vendors: @amd_suzanne @nvidia_anna pls share embargoed matrices on schedule. :thumbsup:
